lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In Brickton, the mayor's birthday cake has one rule.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three hundred years. Not one crumb on the floor.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Which is fine. Because I'm a professional.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Benny was twelve. He was not a professional.

lines.speaker: dough
lines.text: Town square. Noon sharp. And Benny?

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: The long way? It's literally right there!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Benny, it's Pip. Do you have the cake?

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Do I have the cake. Pip. I am the cake. Spiritually.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Officer, I can explain. It's a cake. It's a legal cake—

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Is it a big reason or a—

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Around meant the alley. The alley meant Grandma Rose.

lines.speaker: grandma
lines.text: Benny, sweetie! Help me with my groceries?

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Grandma, I'm holding a seven-layer cake!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then Mr. Fig tried to park.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Mr. Fig! You've been parking since Tuesday!

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: It's a car, Mr. Fig! Not a painting!

lines.speaker: pip
lines.text: Benny, the sprinklers go off at—

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Nope, nope, nope, nope, nope, nope!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The cake stayed dry. Benny did not.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And then, of course, the marching band.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Cake coming through! Excuse me! Cake!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Benny burst into the town square, and…

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Hello? Mayor? Anybody? I have… a cake?

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Wrong day? Is it Tuesday? Mr. Fig, is it Tuesday?!

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: Pip, nobody's here. Is there a second town square?!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The road closure. The groceries. The world's slowest parking.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The whole town had been stalling him for an hour.

lines.speaker: benny
lines.text: I carried my own birthday cake across the entire town?!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And the cake never touched the ground.
